title: Affine neighbourhood containing selected generic points
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-separated, meaning that the intersection of any two quasi-compact open subsets is quasi-compact. Let $x\in X$, and let $\eta_1,\ldots,\eta_r$ be generic points [def-sc-generic-point] of distinct irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components] of $X$, where $r\geq 0$ is finite. Choose one witness from [lemma-nagata-affine-neighbourhood-generic-points-exists] and denote its affine open by $A(x;\eta_1,\ldots,\eta_r)$. Here an affine open is an open subscheme which is affine in the sense of [def-pc-scheme]. Fix this choice for these data; no uniqueness or naturality in the data is asserted.
